```yaml
name: Continue Agents

on:
  workflow_call:
    inputs:
      agents-path:
        description: "Path to the directory containing agent markdown files"
        required: false
        type: string
        default: ".continue/agents"

jobs:
  discover-agents:
    name: Discover Agent Files
    runs-on: ubuntu-latest
    outputs:
      agent-files: ${{ steps.discover.outputs.agent-files }}
    steps:
      - name: Checkout
        uses: actions/checkout@v4

      - name: Discover agent files
        id: discover
        run: |
          AGENTS_PATH="${{ inputs.agents-path }}"
          if [ -d "$AGENTS_PATH" ]; then
            find "$AGENTS_PATH" -name "*.md" -type f | jq -R -s -c 'split("\n")[:-1]' | tee $GITHUB_OUTPUT
          else
            echo "No agents directory found at $AGENTS_PATH" >&2
            exit 1
          fi

  run-agents:
    name: Run Continue Agents
    needs: discover-agents
    runs-on: ubuntu-latest
    permissions:
      contents: read
      checks: write
      pull-requests: write
    strategy:
      matrix:
        agent-file: ${{ fromJSON(needs.discover-agents.outputs.agent-files) }}
      fail-fast: false
    steps:
      - name: Checkout
        uses: actions/checkout@v4

      - name: Setup Node.js
        uses: actions/setup-node@v4
        with:
          node-version: 20
          cache: npm
          cache-dependency-path: package-lock.json

      - name: Install Continue CLI
        run: |
          npm install -g @continuedev/cli

      - name: Run agent
        id: run-agent
        run: |
          AGENT_FILE="${{ matrix.agent-file }}"
          AGENT_NAME=$(basename "$AGENT_FILE" .md)
          
          # Create a temporary file for the output
          OUTPUT_FILE=$(mktemp)
          
          # Run the agent and capture output
          echo "Running agent: $AGENT_NAME"
          continue run "$AGENT_FILE" > "$OUTPUT_FILE" 2>&1
          EXIT_CODE=$?
          
          # Store the output for later use
          cat "$OUTPUT_FILE" | tee -a $GITHUB_STEP_SUMMARY
          
          if [ $EXIT_CODE -ne 0 ]; then
            echo "Agent $AGENT_NAME failed with exit code $EXIT_CODE"
            exit $EXIT_CODE
          fi
          
          # Store output for check run
          echo "output_file=$OUTPUT_FILE" >> $GITHUB_OUTPUT
          echo "agent_name=$AGENT_NAME" >> $GITHUB_OUTPUT

      - name: Create Check Run
        uses: actions/github-script@v7
        with:
          script: |
            const fs = require('fs');
            const { repo, owner } = context.repo;
            const agentName = `${{ steps.run-agent.outputs.agent_name }}`;
            const outputFile = `${{ steps.run-agent.outputs.output_file }}`;
            
            const output = fs.readFileSync(outputFile, 'utf8');
            
            const checkRun = await github.rest.checks.create({
              owner,
              repo,
              name: `Continue Agent: ${agentName}`,
              head_sha: context.sha,
              status: 'completed',
              conclusion: 'success',
              output: {
                title: `Continue Agent: ${agentName}`,
                summary: `Output from agent \`${agentName}\`:\n\n\`\`\`\n${output}\n\`\`\``,
                text: `Agent output:\n\n\`\`\`\n${output}\n\`\`\``
              }
            });
            
            console.log(`Check run created: ${checkRun.data.html_url}`);
```
